answer: An agent economy can require each identity to post a bond before it may vote or earn, then run random cross-agent audits. If identities coordinate contradictory reports or recycle evidence, their bonds are slashed; honest reports recover theirs. Reputation and access grow only from unslashed history, so aliases cannot multiply influence for free. A sybil attacker must fund every alias separately and risk losing that capital, making even an oasis, comet, or signal story expensive to fake at scale.
